questions.explain: 'Der Müll' means 'rubbish/waste'. 'Müll trennen' = 'to separate the rubbish (for recycling)'.
'Der Umweltschutz' means 'environmental protection' (Umwelt + Schutz).

questions.q: How do you say 'My town is too noisy'?
questions.explain: 'Laut' means 'loud/noisy'; 'ruhig' (quiet) is the opposite distractor.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We should save energy'?
questions.explain: 'Sparen' = 'to save' and 'verschwenden' = 'to waste'; 'Wir sollten Energie sparen' = 'We should save energy'.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: At the moment I live in the city
I used to live in the city
I rarely live in the city
I will live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.
'Sich sonnen' means 'to sunbathe' (from 'die Sonne' = sun).

questions.q: How do you say 'There is a swimming pool in my town'?
options: In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Rathaus
In meiner Stadt fehlt ein Schwimmbad
In meiner Stadt gibt es einen Bahnhof
In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Schwimmbad
questions.explain: 'Es gibt' = 'there is' and 'das Schwimmbad' = 'the swimming pool'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I separate the rubbish for recycling'?
options: Ich trenne den Müll zum Recycling
questions.explain: 'Trennen' = 'to separate/sort' and 'zum Recycling' = 'for recycling'.
'Der Wohltätigkeitsverein' means 'a charity (organisation)'.
'Die Unterkunft' means 'accommodation'. 'Food' is 'das Essen'.

questions.q: How do you say 'My house has a large garden'?
options: Meine Wohnung hat einen großen Garten
Mein Haus hat einen kleinen Garten
Mein Haus hat einen großen Garten
questions.explain: 'Einen großen Garten' = 'a large garden'; 'kleinen' (small) is the distractor.
'Erneuerbare Energien' means 'renewable energy' (e.g. wind and solar).

questions.q: What does 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' mean?
options: I live on the outskirts of town
I live in the city centre
questions.explain: 'Der Stadtrand' means 'the edge/outskirts of the town', so 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' = 'I live on the outskirts'.
'Die Gegend' means 'the area/region/neighbourhood', e.g. 'eine ruhige Gegend' = 'a quiet area'.
'Die Überschwemmung' means 'the flood/flooding'.
'Der Flug' means 'the flight'; 'fliegen' = 'to fly'. ('Der Fluss' = river is the near-miss.)

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I would rather go to the mountains'?
options: Ich fahre selten in die Berge
Ich fahre lieber in die Berge
Ich fahre nie in die Berge
questions.explain: 'Lieber' means 'rather/preferably', so 'Ich fahre lieber in die Berge' = 'I'd rather go to the mountains'.
'Der Nachbar' means 'the neighbour' (female: 'die Nachbarin').

questions.q: How do you say 'I always turn off the light'?
options: Ich mache das Licht immer an
Ich mache das Licht nie aus
Ich mache das Licht immer aus
Ich mache die Tür immer zu
questions.explain: 'Ausmachen' = 'to turn off' and 'immer' = 'always'; 'anmachen' (turn on) is the trap.
'Der Treibhauseffekt' means 'the greenhouse effect'.
'Die Bäckerei' means 'the bakery' (from 'backen' = to bake).
